configure.title: Sanduna a Kwance
configure.description: Yana juya layukan jadawalin sanduna don zana jadawalin sanduna a kwance. Ka sani cewa kana kuma buƙatar juya saitunan layukanka domin Layin Y yanzu zai nuna lakabi kuma Layin X ƙimomi.

advanced.title: Yanayin Tarawa
advanced.description: Idan an saita zuwa "true" wannan sifa za ta samar da jimilla ga kowane wurin jeri. Wannan kuma zai shafi layin y da iyakokin jadawalin gaba ɗaya. Idan an saita zuwa "false" wannan sifa za ta tilasta sandunan da aka tara su zana daga layin sifili. A yanayin tarawa sifar "seriesBarDistance" ba za ta yi tasiri ba.
